notes: Window on MAX(invoiceline.LastEditedWhen, invoice.LastEditedWhen): (@LastCutoff, @NewCutoff]. Invoice 1 effective 2020-01-20 (dry item, IsChiller=0, ConfirmedDeliveryTime set); invoice 2 effective 2020-02-20 (chiller item, ConfirmedDeliveryTime NULL -> CAST(NULL AS date) delivery-key branch). ORDER BY InvoiceID, InvoiceLineID.

cases.name: jan-dry-item
cases.why: Jan window -> invoice 1: [Total Dry Items]=Quantity, [Total Chiller Items]=0 (the IsChiller=0 arms). Delivery Date Key is a real date.

cases.name: feb-chiller-item
cases.why: Feb window -> invoice 2: [Total Chiller Items]=Quantity, [Total Dry Items]=0 (the IsChiller<>0 arms). ConfirmedDeliveryTime NULL -> Delivery Date Key is null.

cases.name: both-months
cases.why: Both invoices ordered by InvoiceID -> both chiller/dry arms and the Total Excluding Tax = ExtendedPrice - TaxAmount arithmetic (250.00 and 30.00).

cases.name: upper-boundary-inclusive
cases.why: NewCutoff equals invoice 1's effective timestamp -> included (<= bound).
